name: ...And Feel the Power!
Text: When played as a Counter, ignore 'completely' in the text of your opponent's reversal cards and effects.When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is -3F, +3D, his reversals to it are +20F, and you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: Across the Fifth Dimension
Text: Ignore 'completely' text on your opponent╞s reversals to this card. Promo: 5, reveal the card chosen, and it is considered to be chosen for your Ability for The Interdimensional Oddity. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Big E
Text: When you have equal or lower Fortitude, your opponent must overturn 5 cards to play reversals from hand to your printed non-Follow-up F: 5 or printed D: 5 maneuvers. You can pack No Sell Maneuver and As Big and Tough as Any Two Men, and you are considered to be Kane for its effect. You cannot pack Corners.

name: Big E's Belly-to-Belly
Text: As a maneuver, you may Promo: 3 and then put up to 3 random cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any printed F: 5 or printed D: 5 card.

name: Big E's Big Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter. When played after a printed F: 5 or printed D: 5 card, can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Big Spear Through the Ropes
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -3F and +3D, and can only be played as a Counter. As a reversal, reverse any card that would move cards from any Ringside.
Type: High Risk + High Risk / Reversal: Special

name: Bulgarian Body Block
Text: This card is considered non-Unique for your Ability. When this card is unsuccessful, you may discard 1 maneuver and then put this card in your hand regardless of other effects. During your opponent's turn when this card is in your hand and he moves an F: 0 maneuver from your Ring, you may put this card into your Ring and end his turn.

name: Clap Therapy
Text: Once during any turn when you draw cards for the effects of Cheater or Heel cards, you may draw 1 additional card. When your opponent discards cards for the effects of Cheater or Heel cards, he discards 1 additional card. When you discard any number of cards for the effects of Cheater or Heel cards, you may put them on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Controlling the Pace of the Match
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Backstage Shenanigans. During your opponent's turn, when it is not his first turn of the game, before his Draw Segment you may put this card from your Backlash into your Ring, draw 2- cards, and end his turn. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring, you may overturn 2 cards, and then discard up to 2 cards, put the same number of cards +1 from your Ringside into your hand, and remove this card from the game.

name: Dark Matter
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and cannot be reversed from Backlash. As an action, this card is F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to it; shuffle this card into your Arsenal, and you may put The Prince of Dark Matter from your Ringside or cards removed from the game into your Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any card with µdraw╞ or µshuffle╞ in the text. When this card is in your Ring, your Ability gains: 'Your opponent randomly reveals 1 card drawn for his Draw Segment.'

name: Diamond Dust
Text: Can only be played after Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle or a successfully played 5D+ maneuver. When successfully played, your opponent discards his Backlash. When unsuccessfully played, he may put 1 Mid-match card from his Ringside into his Backlash.

name: Don't Call Me Cody!
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card with Stun Value or any non-maneuver card. When you successfully play a Cody Rhodes-specific card, discard 1 card. When your opponent successfully plays a maneuver or a printed D: 3+ reversal, he discards 1 card.

name: Don't You Dare Be Sour...
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your non-Unique maneuvers without 'reversed' in the text are -1F for every Cheater or Heel card in your Ring. Your Heel maneuvers and Heel reversals are unaffected by your opponent's card effects that would increase their Fortitude or lower their damage.

name: Embrace the Strange
Text: Reverse any card, and the reversed card is considered to be chosen for your Ability for The Interdimensional Oddity. Promo: 5, and put up to 3 of the cards not chosen on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Falling Star
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a Stardust-specific card or as a Counter (with a Stardust-specific card) and cannot be reversed from hand. As an action, this card is -10F, shuffle this card into your Arsenal, your opponent reveals 1 random card from hand, and it is considered to be chosen for your Ability for The Interdimensional Oddity. As a reversal, reverse any card that would move cards from any player's Ringside.

name: Fight Me!
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver, put up to 1 non-hybrid maneuver from your Ringside under Fight Owens Fight, and your opponent puts 1 random card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers with printed Stun Value are +1D and +1 Stun Value.

name: Fight Owens Fight
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for up to 3 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuvers, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card under this card into your hand. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card and all cards under this card into your Ringside, and then your next maneuver played this turn is -5F for each card put into the Ringside for this effect.

name: From the Outer Reaches of the Galaxy
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during the Venue phase. At the end of the Pre-match Phase, overturn 5 cards, put up to 3 cards in your Ringside into your hand, and put 1 card from your hand on top of your Arsenal. When your opponent chooses a maneuver for your Ability: when your Fortitude Rating is 15+, draw up to 1 card; and when the maneuver is F:0 and your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed by hybrid or Unique reversals from hand or Backlash.

name: Hailing from Angel Grove, California
Text: Cannot be blanked or moved from your Ring by your opponent's effects. Ignore 'non-reversal' in your Ability. ACE: During your turn you may put up to 5 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards, and then flip this card face-down and end your turn.

name: Hero of the Russian Federation
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique non-hybrid printed D: 5+ maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When your printed D: 5+ maneuver is unsuccessful, put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal; when you have 5+ lower Fortitude, you may put it in your hand instead.

name: Honor Roll
Text: As an action, this card is F: 0, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and your opponent discards 1 card. When you are Xavier Woods, reversals to this card deal no damage.

name: I Need Five!
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match Phase, put up to 3 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, then draw the same number of cards +1; when NXT Championship Title Belt is in your Ring, draw 1 additional card. When played as a Counter, your maneuvers played from hand that are printed F: 5 or printed D: 5 are -5F and +5D, and ignore 'Can only be played...' text.

name: I've Accomplished More in Months Than You Have in Years
Text: Reverse any non-maneuver card. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 3- cards, he shuffles them into his Arsenal and draws that many. When this card is in your Ring, replace ‘hand’ and ‘Arsenal’ with ‘hand or Arsenal’ in your Ability.

name: If I Can Do That to Him, What Can I Do to You?
Text: When your opponent is Sami Zayn, this card is F: 0. Reverse any Superstar-specific maneuver, and remove the reversed card from the game. At the start of your next turn, you may play that card as if it was in your hand (or Backlash, if applicable) and ignore any 'Can only be played...' text; if you do, after damage is applied, put that card into his Ringside regardless of other effects.

name: It's Morphin' Time!
Text: As an action, search your Arsenal, Ringside, and cards removed from the game for Honor Roll, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect or non-maneuver card. When this card is in your Ring, replace 'discard 1' in your Ability with 'draw up to 1'.

name: Kevin Owens
Text: When your opponent reverses a card from his Arsenal to end your turn, he overturns 2 cards. When he reverses a card from hand to end your turn, draw up to 1 card. Before your first Draw Segment of the game, shuffle # cards from your hand into your Arsenal, where # is the number of cards you have in hand greater than 8.

name: Kevin's Cannonball
Text: Can only be played after a 4D+ maneuver or as a Counter. As a Counter (maneuver), cannot be reversed from Arsenal. As a Counter (non-maneuver), cannot be reversed from hand. When played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: Kevin's Superkick
Text: When played as a Counter, ignore 'completely' in reversal cards and effects to this card. Your opponent discards 1 random card, and reversals to your next card played this turn are +6F.

name: Kofi's Double Chop
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners. This card is also considered a High Risk for your Ability. After you use your Ability, you may put this card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Lost in the Woods
Text: When this card is in your hand and your opponent's effects would move a card from your Ring, you may reveal this card, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, draw 1 card, and your card is not moved.

name: Making a Mockery of the Competition
Text: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. RFG 1 of their Ringside Superstar-specific non-Hybrid actions without 'win the game' in the text, and this card gains that card's text until the end of the turn. This card resolves to the Ring regardless of other effects.

name: Managed by The Ravishing Russian, Lana
Text: Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Your Rusev-specific cards cannot be blanked and do not take up Pre-match slots in your Ring. When you would discard cards to his effects before your first turn of the game, you may instead overturn the same number of cards. When he would draw more than 1 card for his non-Superstar-specific card effects, he draws 1 less card.

name: New... Day Rocks!
Logos: New Day, Big E, Kofi Kingston, Xavier Woods
Text: This card is -1F for each reversal in your opponent's Ring, and when this card would go to your Ringside, put it in your Backlash instead. Draw 1 card, shuffle up to 3 cards from Ringside into your Arsenal, and he overturns 2 cards. ACE: During your turn you may overturn 2 cards, and then put this card in your Backlash and end your turn.

name: Owens' Pop-Up Power Bomb
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card played after a Set-up card. Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may discard 2 cards and then put this card from your Ring into your hand.

name: Pumphandle Neckbreaker
Text: During your turn when this card is in your Ringside and your opponent reverses a maneuver from hand or Arsenal, you may put this card under Fight Owens Fight. This card is -#F, where # is his Fortitude Rating. He discards 2 random cards. When this card is reversed, double the numbers in your Ability under the end of the turn.

name: Rusev
Text: Your non-Unique non-Multi maneuvers without 'reversed' in the text are -2F for every printed D: 5+ Arsenal card in your Ringside. When any player successfully plays a printed F: 10+ card, you may Promo: 2. You can pack As Big and Tough as Any Two Men, Soviet Power, and The Strength of Mother Russia.

name: Rusev's Heel Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -4F, and when played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any card that would move cards from your Ring or Ringside.

name: Rusev's Stomp to the Back
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter. Your opponent puts 2 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. Search your Arsenal and Ringside for The Accolade, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that card is your next card played this turn, it is -10F and cannot be reversed from Backlash.

name: Rusev's Swinging Side Slam
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and +2D, and cannot be reversed by D: 1+ cards. As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver or any card played from Ringside. When this card is in your Ring, your The Accolade cannot be reversed from hand by non-Superstar-specific reversals.

name: Rusev, Crush!
Text: When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, your opponent cannot respond to it. Once during each of your turns when this card is in your hand, you may reveal this card, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw 1 card.

name: Sound the Trombone!
Logos: New Day, Xavier Woods, Santino Marella
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver and can only be reversed by 2 D: 0 reversals. Search your Arsenal for 2 non-Unique maneuvers or 1 Superstar-specific maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Stardust
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may force your opponent to reveal the top 4 cards of his Arsenal. He chooses 1 revealed card, puts it in his hand when it is a reversal, and then shuffles. You can pack non-Foreign Object non-Trademark Finisher Cody Rhodes maneuvers, but you cannot pack Corners. Your Cartwheel is Unique.

name: The Accolade
Text: Your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of Rusev-specific maneuvers in your Ring; this effect cannot be reversed. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may reveal it, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and put 1 non-hybrid maneuver from Ringside in your hand.

name: The Big Ending
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -20F. As a reversal, reverse any effect that would prevent a Pinfall Victory (even during your own turn), or reverse any non-Trademark Finisher-card.

name: The Bulgarian Brute
Text: When you do not have 10+ greater Fortitude and your printed D: 5+ non-Multi maneuver is completely reversed from Arsenal during the first 3 cards while applying damage, before you would draw for Stun Value you may discard 2 cards; your maneuver is not reversed, he puts his reversal on the bottom of his Arsenal and continues to apply damage, he may reverse from Arsenal again as normal, and after all damage is applied end your turn.

name: The Doctor of Defenestration
Text: When you are Xavier Woods, -5F. As an action, Recover this card and 1- RFG card. As a reversal, -10F; when overturned, reverse a non-damage card effect (even during the Pre-match phase), then Recover this card and 3- Ringside cards.

name: The Dreadlocked Dynamo
Text: Reverse any maneuver and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. When this card is in your Ring and your opponent reverses your Kofi Kingston-specific card, he chooses 1 card from hand and puts it on the bottom of his Arsenal; when you have lower Fortitude, the card is randomly chosen instead.

name: The E-Train
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -3F and +3D, and cannot be reversed from Backlash; when successfully played, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any High Risk or any card played after Irish Whip.

name: The Interdimensional Oddity
Text: When the card chosen for your Ability is a reversal, you may look at his hand, choose 1 card with a different title, and he discards the card you chose. When his chosen card is a maneuver, and the next card you play is a maneuver, it is -#F, where # is the Fortitude of his chosen card. When his chosen card is an action or antic, draw up to 1 card.

name: The Midnight Hour
Text: This card is -1F for every card in your Ring that is Cheater or Heel, and ignore 'completely' in reversal cards and effects to it. When you have 15+ cards in your Ring that are Cheater, Heel, or The New Day-specific, this card requires 3 reversals instead of 2 and cannot be reversed from Arsenal by non-Unique cards.

name: The Minister of Mass
Text: Draw up to 3 cards, shuffle up to 3 cards from Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns 3 cards.

name: The New Day
Text: When you successfully play a Cheater or Heel card, you may Promo: 3 and then put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. You can pack Kofi Kingston Arsenal maneuvers, but you cannot pack Flurry of Finishers. When you are not packing Face cards, you can pack both Fan Favorite and Cheater cards; when you are not packing Fan Favorite cards, you can pack both Face and Heel cards. You are a Tag Team.

name: The Power of Positivity
Logos: New Day, Big E, Kofi Kingston, Xavier Woods
Text: As an action, shuffle this card and up to 1 card from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, this card is -4F and when overturned, completely reverse any Cheater, Face, Fan Favorite, or Heel card.

name: The Prince of Dark Matter
Text: When your opponent choose a maneuver for your Ability this turn, he cannot respond to this card. When this card is in your Ring: your Dark Matter is -5F; he cannot draw more than 2 cards when drawing for Stun Value; and when you successfully play a maneuver without Stun Value or when he successfully plays a maneuver with Stun Value, put up to 1 random card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The Prizefighter
Text: You are considered to have Roll Out of the Ring in your Ring for Apron Bomb. When you have a Title Belt in your Ring and you use your Ability, put up to 1 non-reversal maneuver in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you do not have a Title Belt in your Ring, he has a Title Belt in his Ring, and you have lower Fortitude, add 1 to the numbers in your Ability.

name: The Queen's Crossbow
Text: Cannot be packed by The Rhodes Brothers. Can be played from your Backstage Area. Can only be played after a 3D+ maneuver or as a Counter, and when successfully played, your opponent puts 4 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When this card is in your hand or Ringside and you successfully play a Stardust-specific card, you may put this card in your Backstage Area and draw 1 card.

name: The Russian Flag
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is F: 10- and your printed D: 5+ maneuver is unsuccessful, your opponent puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal; when your maneuver was not Chain and he has greater reversals in Ring, he puts 2 cards instead. When your effects move a maneuver from your Ring, hide this card. During any turn, you may hide this card and then your next non-hybrid action or reversal card played that turn is -5F.

name: The Super Athlete
Text: This card is -#F, where # is half of your opponent's Fortitude Rating, rounded down. As an action, you may Promo: 2; when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your next maneuver played this turn is F: 0, Chain, Multi, and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. As a reversal, reverse any card that would move cards that are removed from the game or in any player's Ringside. When this card is in your Ring, ignore the 'non-Superstar-specific' text on your Managed by The Ravishing Russian, Lana, and your Superstar-specific maneuvers are Chain when played.

name: Three Ain't Enough!
Text: You may replace '3' with '5' in the text of your other Superstar-specific cards. At the start of each of your turns when you have 3- cards in hand, you may skip your Draw Segment and draw until you have 5 cards in hand.

name: Tricep Meat
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may either remove 1 card in your Backlash from the game OR allow your opponent to Promo: 2. When you do, search your Arsenal for 1 card titled Bear Hug, Belly to Belly Suplex, Body Block, Body Lock, Forearm Uppercut, Front Chancery, Gut Buster, Knee Lift, Rapid-Fire Punches, Splash, Superkick, or Suplex, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Once during each of your turns, you may discard a card listed on this card, and then your next maneuver played is -5F.

name: Unicorn Stampede
Logos: New Day, Big E, Kofi Kingston, Xavier Woods
Text: When you are a Stable, this card requires 3 reversals to reverse instead of 2; when you are not, this card is -3F. When you are Kofi Kingston, this card is also considered a High Risk for your Ability. When you have lower fortitude, ignore 'completely' in reversals and reversal effects to this card.

name: Written In The Stars
Text: When your opponent plays a non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card with 'stun' in the text, he discards 1 card. Your Superstar-specific cards are considered to not have Stun Value for your effects. Your Cartwheel is also 'Reversal: Card with Stun Value'.

name: Xavier Woods
Text: When you unsuccessfully play a maneuver or NXT card, shuffle up to 1 non-reversal card from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When you flip a card face-up, discard 1 card. Your Superstar-specific cards are now NXT. You can pack Backed by The Funkadactyls, Funk Is On a Roll! and Somebody Call My Mama! You cannot pack Corners.

name: Xavier Woods Interferes
Logos: Big E, Kofi Kingston, New Day
Text: When played from hand, reverse any card, Promo: 3 and then put 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.
